sheets.label: A WEEK OF ENERGY · NO SCORE KEPT
sheets.intro: Track where your energy actually goes — no scoring, no streaks, just a picture over a week. Each day, circle where you were, then jot what drained you and what put something back. An empty day is information, not a failure. Print one a week and keep it where you'll see it.
columns: What helped or put some back
sheets.glanceSub: Count how many days landed on each. That's the whole summary — patterns show up on their own after two or three weeks.
sheets.note: ONE SHEET A WEEK · CIRCLE, DON'T SCORE · KEEP THE OLD ONES, THEY ADD UP TO SOMETHING
